experiment_data.hypothesis: 验证 traj-level-finetuned 的 2.75pp gap（vs per-test classification）在不同 seed 下稳定存在，确认统计显著性
experiment_data.notes:
Traj-level seed 456: accuracy=87.4%, unresolved_f1=88.7%, resolved_f1=85.8%, consistency=78.8%。

## 3-seed 汇总（traj-level）
| seed | accuracy | unresolved_f1 | resolved_f1 | consistency |
|------|----------|---------------|-------------|-------------|
| 42   | 85.66    | 87.50         | 83.18       | 79.94       |
| 123  | 85.47    | 87.00         | 83.52       | 78.59       |

## vs Per-test Classification (3-seed mean)
- Per-test cls: accuracy=88.41±0.96, F1=88.41±1.01
- Traj-level:   accuracy=86.18±1.06, F1(mean)=85.95
- **Gap: 2.23pp accuracy, 2.46pp F1**

## 结论
Per-test classification 在所有 3 seeds 下均优于 traj-level（gap 1.01-3.94pp），确认 per-test granularity 的信息优势稳定存在。seed 456 traj accuracy 异常高（87.4%），拉近了 gap，但仍不逆转。Consistency rate 三 seed 稳定在 78-80%。
